title.narrative: Promoting good governance in education through community-centred accountability

description.narrative:
Overall objective: Improved transparency and accountability leading to reduced corruption in the education sector in South Africa through youth-led activism.  

Specific objectives:

1. Active, engaged and empowered cohort of youth in South Africa alive to the available mechanisms to tackle corruption within education and the country more broadly.

2. Strengthened accountability mechanisms to hold government, schools, governing bodies, teachers, parents and the private sector accountable for inclusive equitable quality education.

3. New and improved, responsive, child-friendly platforms and mechanisms for reporting and monitoring incidents of corruption in education provisioning, developed in collaboration with key sector stakeholders.
